versions.content: Within SoAd_TcpIpEvent() with Event set to TCPIP_UDP_CLOSED, SoAd shall (1) remove the assignment of the TcpIp socket identified by SocketId from the related UDP socket connection group and (2) close all socket connections of the related so cket connection group that are in SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE (i.e. perform the specified closing actions with the exception of closing related TcpIp sockets)
